About the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic

As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted in a marbleized pattern. The Desert Eagle | Hypnotic is a Classified-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Hypnotic finish on the Desert Eagle. With a Classified rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.64% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The Desert Eagle | Hypnotic can be unboxed from the CS:GO Weapon Case. It belongs to the Arms Deal Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.08. With a maximum float of 0.08, this skin can only exist in near-Factory New condition, meaning every copy looks exceptionally clean. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The Desert Eagle | Hypnotic (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $333.48, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $228.34 (Minimal Wear) to $333.48 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The Desert Eagle | Hypnotic has a community rating of 3.9 out of 5 based on 217 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among Desert Eagle skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic?

Factory New (FN) Desert Eagle | Hypnotic skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. This skin has a restricted float range (0.00-0.08), meaning Battle-Scarred versions don't exist. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Hypnotic pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic worth the price?

The Desert Eagle | Hypnotic sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Hypnotic design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Arms Deal Collection, obtainable from the CS:GO Weapon Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the Desert Eagle, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). This is a restricted float skin that can only drop in Factory New or near-FN condition, making all examples relatively clean. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic?

Prices for the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the CS:GO Weapon Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Is the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic a good investment?

Investment potential depends on several factors. The Desert Eagle | Hypnotic is from the The Arms Deal Collection (CS:GO Weapon Case) — skins from discontinued collections tend to appreciate as supply decreases over time. Key considerations: (1) Check the 30-day and 90-day price trends in the charts above; (2) Evaluate overall CS2 market conditions. Past performance doesn't guarantee future returns, but the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic has maintained steady trading interest. Diversifying across multiple items typically reduces risk.

Can I use the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic price going up or down?

The Desert Eagle | Hypnotic has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic from?

The Desert Eagle | Hypnotic is part of the The Arms Deal Collection. It can be obtained by opening the CS:GO Weapon Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the Desert Eagle | Hypnotic?

The in-game description reads: "As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted in a marbleized pattern." The Hypnotic finish on the Desert Eagle is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.
